actions.clear_notification.description: Mark a notification as read and dismiss it from phones and the web app. Requires ntfy server v2.16.0 or later.
actions.clear_notification.props.sequenc: The notification to clear: the Message ID returned when it was sent, or the Sequence ID you gave it, e.g. backup-job-42.
actions.clear_notification.props.topic.d: The topic name, e.g. backups_home. 1-64 characters: letters, digits, "-" and "_". Anyone who knows a public topic name can read it, so pick a hard-to-guess name.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_notification.description: Remove a notification from phones and the web app, or cancel a scheduled one before it is delivered. Requires ntfy server v2.16.0 or later.
actions.delete_notification.props.sequen: The notification to delete or cancel: the Message ID returned when it was sent, or the Sequence ID you gave it, e.g. reminder-42.
The topic name, e.g. backups_home. 1-64 characters: letters, digits, "-" and "_". Anyone who knows a public topic name can read it, so pick a hard-to-guess name.
actions.fetch_messages.description: Read messages that the ntfy server has cached for one or more topics. A message sent a few seconds ago may not be listed yet.
actions.fetch_messages.props.include_eve: Also return the message_clear and message_delete events created by Clear/Delete Notification.
actions.fetch_messages.props.limit.descr: Maximum number of messages to return (newest first), 1-1000. Defaults to 100.
actions.fetch_messages.props.message.des: Only return messages whose body is exactly this text.
actions.fetch_messages.props.priority.de: Only return messages with any of these priorities. Leave empty for all.
actions.fetch_messages.props.since.descr: How far back to read: a duration (2h), a Unix timestamp, a message ID (messages after it), "latest" or "all". Defaults to 12h.
actions.fetch_messages.props.tags.descri: Only return messages that have all of these tags, e.g. backup.
actions.fetch_messages.props.title.descr: Only return messages whose title is exactly this text.
actions.fetch_messages.props.topics.desc: One topic, or several separated by commas, e.g. alerts,backups_home. Letters, digits, "-" and "_" only.
actions.list_scheduled_messages.descript: List messages that are scheduled for later delivery and have not been delivered yet. A message scheduled a few seconds ago may not be listed yet.
actions.list_scheduled_messages.props.to: One topic, or several separated by commas, e.g. alerts,backups_home. Letters, digits, "-" and "_" only.
actions.ntfy_check_server_health.descrip: Check that the ntfy server on the connection is up and accepts the connection's token.
actions.ntfy_get_account.description: Get the ntfy account behind the connection, with its limits and usage today.
actions.ntfy_get_attachment_info.descrip: Check whether a file uploaded with a notification is still on the ntfy server, and its size.
actions.ntfy_get_attachment_info.props.m: ID of the message the file was uploaded with, e.g. TCZJOKUErDsd (the "id" returned by Send File). A trailing file extension such as .txt is ignored.
actions.ntfy_get_server_stats.descriptio: Get the total number of messages the ntfy server has published and its current message rate.
actions.ntfy_publish_message.description: Publish a notification to a ntfy topic with typed fields.
actions.ntfy_publish_message.props.actio: Up to 3 buttons as a JSON array, e.g. [{"action":"view","label":"Open","url":"https://example.com"}]. Types: view, http, broadcast, copy. See https://docs.ntfy.sh/publish/#action-buttons
actions.ntfy_publish_message.props.attac: Public URL of a file to attach, e.g. https://example.com/report.pdf. ntfy does not download it; the apps link to it.
Also read the message out in a phone call to this number, e.g. +12223334444, or "yes" for your first verified number. Needs a paid ntfy.sh plan (or a self-hosted server with Twilio) and a verified number.
actions.ntfy_publish_message.props.click: Web page or app link opened when the notification is tapped, e.g. https://example.com/orders/42
actions.ntfy_publish_message.props.delay: Schedule delivery for later: a duration (30m, 2h, 1 day), a Unix timestamp or natural language like 'tomorrow, 10am'. Between 10 seconds and 3 days on default servers.
actions.ntfy_publish_message.props.disab: Deliver only to clients connected right now; the message cannot be fetched later. Cannot be combined with Delay.
Skip Firebase push (Google Play Android apps then only get it while connected).
actions.ntfy_publish_message.props.email: Also send the notification to this email address, e.g. jane@example.com. ntfy.sh allows 5 emails a day without an account; with an access token, ntfy.sh only sends to addresses verified in the account settings.
actions.ntfy_publish_message.props.filen: Name shown for the attachment, e.g. report.pdf. Only used together with an attachment.
URL of a JPEG or PNG image used as the notification icon, e.g. https://example.com/icon.png
actions.ntfy_publish_message.props.markd: Render the message as Markdown (supported in the web app and on Android).
actions.ntfy_publish_message.props.messa: Notification body, up to 4,096 bytes, e.g. "Backup finished in 4m 12s". ntfy uses "triggered" when empty (or "You received a file: <name>" with an attachment).
actions.ntfy_publish_message.props.prior: Whole number 1 (min) to 5 (max, urgent). Leave empty for the default 3.
actions.ntfy_publish_message.props.seque: Your own ID for this notification, e.g. backup-job-42, so later steps can update, clear or delete it. Letters, digits, "-" and "_". Needs ntfy server v2.16.0+.
Tags shown with the notification. Tags that match an emoji short code (e.g. warning, white_check_mark, rotating_light) are shown as that emoji.
actions.ntfy_publish_message.props.title: Optional notification title, e.g. "Backup finished". Defaults to the topic URL in the apps.
Title
actions.ntfy_publish_message.props.topic: The topic name, e.g. backups_home. 1-64 characters: letters, digits, "-" and "_". Anyone who knows a public topic name can read it, so pick a hard-to-guess name.
actions.send_file.description: Send a notification with a file from your flow attached. ntfy.sh accepts files up to 2 MB without an account; self-hosted servers allow 15 MB by default.
actions.send_file.props.click.descriptio: Web page or app link opened when the notification is tapped, e.g. https://example.com/orders/42
actions.send_file.props.delay.descriptio: Schedule delivery for later: a duration (30m, 2h, 1 day), a Unix timestamp or natural language like 'tomorrow, 10am'. Between 10 seconds and 3 days on default servers.
actions.send_file.props.file.description: The file to attach, e.g. the output of a previous step.
actions.send_file.props.filename.descrip: Name shown for the file, e.g. report.pdf. Defaults to the file's own name.
actions.send_file.props.message.descript: Notification body, up to 4,096 bytes. Leave empty and ntfy shows "You received a file: <file name>".
actions.send_file.props.priority.descrip: How urgently the phone should alert. Leave empty for the default (3).
actions.send_file.props.tags.description: Tags shown with the notification. Tags that match an emoji short code (e.g. warning, white_check_mark, rotating_light) are shown as that emoji.
actions.send_file.props.title.descriptio: Optional notification title, e.g. "Backup finished". Defaults to the topic URL in the apps.
actions.send_file.props.topic.descriptio: The topic name, e.g. backups_home. 1-64 characters: letters, digits, "-" and "_". Anyone who knows a public topic name can read it, so pick a hard-to-guess name.
Add Action buttons to notifications, see https://docs.ntfy.sh/publish/#action-buttons
actions.send_notification.props.attach.d: Public URL of a file to attach, e.g. https://example.com/report.pdf. ntfy does not download it; the apps link to it.
actions.send_notification.props.cache.de: Leave empty to let the server cache the message (default), so it can be fetched later. "Do not cache" delivers it only to clients connected right now.
actions.send_notification.props.call.des: Also read the message out in a phone call to this number, e.g. +12223334444, or "yes" for your first verified number. Needs a paid ntfy.sh plan (or a self-hosted server with Twilio) and a verified number.
actions.send_notification.props.click.de: You can define which URL to open when a notification is clicked, see https://docs.ntfy.sh/publish/#click-action
actions.send_notification.props.delay.de: Let ntfy send messages at a later date, e.g. 'tomorrow, 10am', see https://docs.ntfy.sh/publish/#scheduled-delivery
actions.send_notification.props.email.de: Also send the notification to this email address, e.g. jane@example.com. ntfy.sh allows 5 emails a day without an account; with an access token, ntfy.sh only sends to addresses verified in the account settings.
actions.send_notification.props.filename: Name shown for the attachment, e.g. report.pdf. Only used together with an attachment.
actions.send_notification.props.firebase: Leave empty to also push through Firebase (default, needed for instant delivery on Google Play Android apps). "Do not forward" skips Firebase.
actions.send_notification.props.icon.des: The absolute URL to your icon, e.g. https://example.com/communityIcon_xnt6chtnr2j21.png
actions.send_notification.props.markdown: Render the message as Markdown (supported in the web app and on Android).
actions.send_notification.props.priority: The priority of the notification (1-5). 1 is lowest priority.
actions.send_notification.props.sequence: Your own ID for this notification, e.g. backup-job-42, so later steps can update, clear or delete it. Letters, digits, "-" and "_". Needs ntfy server v2.16.0+.
actions.send_notification.props.topic.de: The topic/channel to send the notification to, e.g. test1
actions.update_notification.description: Replace a notification already sent (or still scheduled) with new content, e.g. a progress update. Fields left empty are not copied from the original. Requires ntfy server v2.16.0 or later.
actions.update_notification.props.action: Up to 3 buttons as a JSON array, e.g. [{"action":"view","label":"Open","url":"https://example.com"}]. Types: view, http, broadcast, copy. See https://docs.ntfy.sh/publish/#action-buttons
actions.update_notification.props.attach: Public URL of a file to attach, e.g. https://example.com/report.pdf. ntfy does not download it; the apps link to it.
Web page or app link opened when the notification is tapped, e.g. https://example.com/orders/42
Schedule delivery for later: a duration (30m, 2h, 1 day), a Unix timestamp or natural language like 'tomorrow, 10am'. Between 10 seconds and 3 days on default servers.
actions.update_notification.props.filena: Name shown for the attachment, e.g. report.pdf. Only used together with an attachment.
actions.update_notification.props.icon.d: URL of a JPEG or PNG image used as the notification icon, e.g. https://example.com/icon.png
actions.update_notification.props.markdo: Render the message as Markdown (supported in the web app and on Android).
actions.update_notification.props.messag: The new notification body, up to 4,096 bytes, e.g. "Download 50% done".
actions.update_notification.props.priori: How urgently the phone should alert. Leave empty for the default (3).
actions.update_notification.props.sequen: The notification to replace: the Message ID returned when it was sent, or the Sequence ID you gave it, e.g. backup-job-42.
actions.update_notification.props.tags.d: Tags shown with the notification. Tags that match an emoji short code (e.g. warning, white_check_mark, rotating_light) are shown as that emoji.
Optional notification title, e.g. "Backup finished". Defaults to the topic URL in the apps.
The topic name, e.g. backups_home. 1-64 characters: letters, digits, "-" and "_". Anyone who knows a public topic name can read it, so pick a hard-to-guess name.
auth.description:
To obtain a token:

  1. Log in to your Ntfy instance.
  2. Click on Account
  3. Go under, on Access tokens and click on the button icon to copy your Token or CREATE ACCESS TOKEN if you do not have
  4. Please pay attention to the expiration time when copying/creating a Token.
  4. Copy your access token & and paste them into the fields below.
triggers.new_message.description: Triggers when a message is published to a ntfy topic. Needs the server to cache messages (ntfy.sh keeps them 12 hours); messages sent with "Do not cache" are never seen.
triggers.new_message.props.priority.desc: Only trigger for messages with any of these priorities. Leave empty for all.
triggers.new_message.props.tags.descript: Only trigger for messages that have all of these tags, e.g. backup.
triggers.new_message.props.topics.descri: One topic, or several separated by commas, e.g. alerts,backups_home. Letters, digits, "-" and "_" only.
